modules.name: Mobile App – Common
modules.description: Features shared by all users of the mobile app, such as login, notifications, notice board, contact directory, profile and language.

modules.name: Notice Board
modules.description: A separate project within the app for announcements, celebrations and events.

requirements.title: OTP login
requirements.description: The mobile app must let users log in with an OTP.

requirements.title: Switch between flats or roles
requirements.description: Users must be able to switch between flats or roles within the mobile app.

requirements.title: Notifications
requirements.description: The mobile app must provide notifications to users.

requirements.title: Notice Board for announcements, celebrations, events
requirements.description: The app must include a Notice Board, described as its own project, covering announcements, celebrations and events.

requirements.title: Contact directory with tap to call
requirements.description: The mobile app must provide a contact directory where a user can tap a contact to call.

requirements.title: User profile
requirements.description: The mobile app must provide a Profile feature for users.

requirements.title: Language support: English, Gujarati, Hindi
requirements.description: The mobile app must support the English, Gujarati and Hindi languages.
